name: Mi'kmaq (Grand Council flag)
description: A white field with a red cross set toward the hoist, a red five-pointed star in the upper hoist and a red crescent in the lower hoist.
history: The flag of the Santé Mawiómi, the Mi'kmaq Grand Council. The cross recalls the nation's early adoption of Christianity (Grand Chief Membertou was baptized in 1610); the sun and moon stand for the forces that govern day and night. Traditionally flown both horizontally and vertically.
